mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00023.retrieveConfirmExistsData */ CASE WHEN COUNT(pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS confirm_exists_flag /* 확정건 존재유무. payMonth, payType에 대한 확정건이 있는 경우 연차수정불가 체크하기 위한 값 */ FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcpb , tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce WHERE pcpb.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value IN (SELECT TO_CHAR(pce1.basis_date, 'YYYYMM') /* 급여인 경우 BASIS_DATE 의 년월이 PAY MONTH 와 일치함 */ FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce1 WHERE pce1.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pce1.payroll_type_code IN ('MTH', 'MTH_RS') ) AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(pcpb.start_yyyymmdd, 'yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE(pcpb.end_yyyymmdd, 'yyyymmdd') AND pce.payroll_type_code = #{payrollTypeCode} AND NVL(pce.confirm_flag, 'N') = 'Y' /* 확정건 */

SELECT /* LGVPAY00023.retrieveRetireeAnnualLeaveList */ main.employee_no ,main.full_name AS employee_name ,TO_CHAR(main.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS start_date ,TO_CHAR(main.attendance_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS calc_start_date ,TO_CHAR(main.attendance_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS resignation_date ,NVL(( SELECT ata.residual_annual_leave_days FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n ata WHERE ata.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = to_char(add_months(TRUNC(to_date(SUBSTR(main.time_and_attendance_yyyymm,1,4),'yyyy'),'year'),-1),'yyyymm') AND ata.employee_no = main.employee_no ),0) AS accumulation_last_year /*"Accumulation from Last Year(1)"--전년도 잔여년차 */ ,main.yearly_annual_leave_days AS creation_this_year /*"Creation from This Year(2)" -- 개인별 연간 발생 연차일수 */ ,al.occur_basic_annual_leave_days AS creation_fifth_year /* Creation from 5 Year -- 5년주기로 생성되는 연차 */ ,main.yearly_annual_used_days AS used_al_this_year /*"Used AL at This Year(4)" -- 개인별 연간 사용 연차일수 "Used Annual Leave at This Year(4)" */ ,main.full_days AS full_days /*"Full Days"*/ ,main.working_days AS working_days /*"Working Days"*/ ,main.unpaid_days AS unpaid_days /*"Unpaid Days"*/ ,al.annual_calibration_days AS adj_days /*"Adj days"*/ ,al.annual_compensation_days AS pay_days /*"Pay days" */ ,al.residual_annual_leave_days AS remain_days /*"Remain Days"*/
,ROUND((main.working_days - main.unpaid_days) / main.full_days * 12, 0) AS calc_adj_days -- 개인별 연간 보정 연차일수(계산할떄 사용) ,GREATEST(0, (ROUND((main.working_days - main.unpaid_days) / main.full_days * 12, 0) - main.yearly_annual_leave_days)) AS calc_diffdays -- 개인별 차이 연차일수(계산할때 사용)
,main.time_and_attendance_yyyymm FROM ( SELECT ar.employee_no ,ar.full_name ,ar.full_days ,ar.working_days ,ar.unpaid_days ,ar.date_hire_subsidiary ,ar.attendance_start_date ,ar.attendance_end_date ,NVL(SUM(aa.occur_monthly_ann_lv_days), 0) AS yearly_annual_leave_days -- 개인별 연간 발생 연차일수 ,NVL(SUM(aa.use_annual_leave_days), 0) AS yearly_annual_used_days -- 개인별 연간 사용 연차일수 ,MAX(aa.time_and_attendance_yyyymm) AS time_and_attendance_yyyymm -- 최종 년월
FROM ( SELECT ar.subsidiary_code ,ar.employee_no ,em.full_name ,em.date_hire_subsidiary ,em.attendance_start_date ,em.attendance_end_date ,em.full_days -- 1년 만근일수 ,(em.attendance_end_date - em.attendance_start_date + 1) AS working_days -- 개인별 만근일수 ,NVL(SUM(ac.unpaid_days), 0) AS unpaid_days -- 개인별 무급일수 FROM ( SELECT em.subsidiary_code AS subsidiary_code ,em.employee_number AS employee_number ,em.full_name_local AS full_name ,(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'YYYY') || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'YYYY') || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) AS full_days -- 1년 만근일수 ,GREATEST(em.date_hire_subsidiary, TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'YYYY') || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) AS attendance_start_date -- 개인별 기산시작일 ,em.date_retire AS attendance_end_date -- 개인별 기산종료일 ,em.date_hire_subsidiary FROM tb_pay_calc_set_target_per_n ps ,emp_master em WHERE ps.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} -- 급여대상자SetId AND ps.employee_no = em.employee_number AND em.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND em.date_retire IS NOT NULL -- 퇴직자만
AND em.date_retire <= ( SELECT last_day(TO_DATE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue},'mm/yyyy')) FROM dual)
) em, tb_att_result_n ar, tb_att_code_c ac WHERE em.subsidiary_code = ar.subsidiary_code AND em.employee_number = ar.employee_no AND ar.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN em.attendance_start_date AND em.attendance_end_date AND ar.subsidiary_code = ac.subsidiary_code AND ar.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code GROUP BY ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, em.attendance_start_date, em.attendance_end_date, full_days,date_hire_subsidiary,em.full_name ) ar, tb_att_annual_leave_n aa WHERE ar.subsidiary_code = aa.subsidiary_code AND ar.employee_no = aa.employee_no AND aa.time_and_attendance_yyyymm BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ar.attendance_start_date, 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(ar.attendance_end_date, 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY ar.employee_no,ar.full_name, ar.full_days, ar.working_days, ar.unpaid_days,ar.date_hire_subsidiary,ar.attendance_start_date,ar.attendance_end_date ) main , tb_att_annual_leave_n al WHERE al.employee_no = main.employee_no AND al.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = main.time_and_attendance_yyyymm ORDER BY main.employee_no

SELECT /* LGVPAY00023.createCSVDownloadData */ employee_no , employee_name , start_date , calc_start_date , resignation_date , accumulation_last_year , creation_this_year , total_al_this_year , used_al_this_year , full_days , working_days , unpaid_days , adj_days , pay_days , remain_days FROM ( SELECT '1' AS gubun ,(SELECT lslm.label_name FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.employeeNo' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS employee_no ,(SELECT lslm.label_name FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.employeeName' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS employee_name ,(SELECT lslm.label_name FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'StartDate' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS start_date ,(SELECT lslm.label_name FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.calcStartDate' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS calc_start_date ,(SELECT lslm.label_name FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.resignationDate' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS resignation_date ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.accmulationFromLastYear' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS accumulation_last_year /*"Accumulation from Last Year(1)"--전년도 잔여년차 */ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.creationFromThisYear' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS creation_this_year /*"Creation from This Year(2)" -- 개인별 연간 발생 연차일수 */ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.totalAnnualLeaveOfThisYear' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS total_al_this_year /* accumulation_last_year + creation_this_year */ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.usedAnnualLeaveAtThisYear' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS used_al_this_year /*"Used AL at This Year(4)" -- 개인별 연간 사용 연차일수 "Used Annual Leave at This Year(4)" */ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.fullDays' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS full_days /*"Full Days"*/ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.workingDaysThisYear' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS working_days /*"Working Days"*/ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.unpaidDaysThisYear' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS unpaid_days /*"Unpaid Days"*/ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.adjustDays' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS adj_days /*"Adj days"*/ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.payDays' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS pay_days /*"Pay days" */ ,(SELECT REPLACE(lslm.label_name, '
', ' ') FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.remainDays' AND lslm.language_code = #{languageCode}) AS remain_days /*"Remain Days"*/
FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT '2' AS gubun ,main.employee_no ,main.full_name AS employee_name ,TO_CHAR(main.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS start_date ,TO_CHAR(main.attendance_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS calc_start_date ,TO_CHAR(main.attendance_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS resignation_date ,TO_CHAR(NVL(( SELECT ata.residual_annual_leave_days FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n ata WHERE ata.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = to_char(add_months(TRUNC(to_date(SUBSTR(main.time_and_attendance_yyyymm,1,4),'yyyy'),'year'),-1),'yyyymm') AND ata.employee_no = main.employee_no ),0), 'FM9,990.0') AS accumulation_last_year /*"Accumulation from Last Year(1)"--전년도 잔여년차 */ ,TO_CHAR(main.yearly_annual_leave_days, 'FM9,990.0') AS creation_this_year /*"Creation from This Year(2)" -- 개인별 연간 발생 연차일수 */
,TO_CHAR(NVL(( SELECT ata.residual_annual_leave_days FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n ata WHERE ata.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = to_char(add_months(TRUNC(to_date(SUBSTR(main.time_and_attendance_yyyymm,1,4),'yyyy'),'year'),-1),'yyyymm') AND ata.employee_no = main.employee_no ),0) + main.yearly_annual_leave_days, 'FM9,990.0') AS total_al_this_year /* accumulation_last_year + creation_this_year */
,TO_CHAR(main.yearly_annual_used_days , 'FM9,990.0') AS used_al_this_year /*"Used AL at This Year(4)" -- 개인별 연간 사용 연차일수 "Used Annual Leave at This Year(4)" */ ,TO_CHAR(main.full_days , 'FM9,990.0') AS full_days /*"Full Days"*/ ,TO_CHAR(main.working_days , 'FM9,990.0') AS working_days /*"Working Days"*/ ,TO_CHAR(main.unpaid_days , 'FM9,990.0') AS unpaid_days /*"Unpaid Days"*/ ,TO_CHAR(al.annual_calibration_days , 'FM9,990.0') AS adj_days /*"Adj days"*/ ,TO_CHAR(al.annual_compensation_days , 'FM9,990.0') AS pay_days /*"Pay days" */ ,TO_CHAR(al.residual_annual_leave_days, 'FM9,990.0') AS remain_days /*"Remain Days"*/
FROM ( SELECT ar.employee_no ,ar.full_name ,ar.full_days ,ar.working_days ,ar.unpaid_days ,ar.date_hire_subsidiary ,ar.attendance_start_date ,ar.attendance_end_date ,NVL(SUM(aa.occur_monthly_ann_lv_days), 0) AS yearly_annual_leave_days -- 개인별 연간 발생 연차일수 ,NVL(SUM(aa.use_annual_leave_days), 0) AS yearly_annual_used_days -- 개인별 연간 사용 연차일수 ,MAX(aa.time_and_attendance_yyyymm) AS time_and_attendance_yyyymm -- 최종 년월
FROM ( SELECT ar.subsidiary_code ,ar.employee_no ,em.full_name ,em.date_hire_subsidiary ,em.attendance_start_date ,em.attendance_end_date ,em.full_days -- 1년 만근일수 ,(em.attendance_end_date - em.attendance_start_date + 1) AS working_days -- 개인별 만근일수 ,NVL(SUM(ac.unpaid_days), 0) AS unpaid_days -- 개인별 무급일수 FROM ( SELECT em.subsidiary_code AS subsidiary_code ,em.employee_number AS employee_number ,em.full_name_local AS full_name ,(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'YYYY') || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'YYYY') || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD') + 1) AS full_days -- 1년 만근일수 ,GREATEST(em.date_hire_subsidiary, TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'YYYY') || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) AS attendance_start_date -- 개인별 기산시작일 ,em.date_retire AS attendance_end_date -- 개인별 기산종료일 ,em.date_hire_subsidiary FROM tb_pay_calc_set_target_per_n ps ,emp_master em WHERE ps.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} -- 급여대상자SetId AND ps.employee_no = em.employee_number AND em.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND em.date_retire IS NOT NULL -- 퇴직자만
AND em.date_retire <= ( SELECT last_day(to_date(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue},'mm/yyyy')) FROM dual)
) em, tb_att_result_n ar, tb_att_code_c ac WHERE em.subsidiary_code = ar.subsidiary_code AND em.employee_number = ar.employee_no AND ar.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN em.attendance_start_date AND em.attendance_end_date AND ar.subsidiary_code = ac.subsidiary_code AND ar.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code GROUP BY ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, em.attendance_start_date, em.attendance_end_date, full_days,date_hire_subsidiary,em.full_name ) ar, tb_att_annual_leave_n aa WHERE ar.subsidiary_code = aa.subsidiary_code AND ar.employee_no = aa.employee_no AND aa.time_and_attendance_yyyymm BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ar.attendance_start_date, 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(ar.attendance_end_date, 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY ar.employee_no,ar.full_name, ar.full_days, ar.working_days, ar.unpaid_days,ar.date_hire_subsidiary,ar.attendance_start_date,ar.attendance_end_date ) main , tb_att_annual_leave_n al WHERE al.employee_no = main.employee_no AND al.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = main.time_and_attendance_yyyymm )

UPDATE /* LGVPAY00023.updateAnnualLeave */ tb_att_annual_leave_n SET annual_compensation_days = NVL(#{payDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) /* 연차보상일수 */ , residual_annual_leave_days = 0 /* 잔여연차휴가일수 */ , last_update_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일자 */ WHERE subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */ AND employee_no = #{employeeNo} /* 사원번호 */
AND time_and_attendance_yyyymm >= #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}
